    },
    {
      "id": "r:5097038039",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Space characters in returned keys bypass CRLF checks and allow injecting ADD_ONION arguments such as Port= or Flags=Detach",

    {
      "id": "rc:3920374363",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Check the cached key in auth_cb before building ADD_ONION and name the file to remove in the warning",

      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",

      "status": "fixed",

      "type": "suggestion",

      "fix_pushed": false,

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Ensure the cached key file does not exist before running the test so assert_equal does not pass falsely",

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Turn m_service_id into a local variable inside TorController::add_onion_cb() since it is not used elsewhere",
      "quote": "why is this even a member variable? It is used only inside TorController::add_onion_cb(). I think it should be turned into a local variable inside the method.",

      "status": "accepted",

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Assign m_service to a local variable and only assign to the member variable after validating it",

      "status": "accepted",

      "text": "Avoid caching PRIVATE_KEY_NEW if Tor returns a ServiceID without a PrivateKey",
